examples.arabic: مشمش كانت مستنياهم عند باب الشقة.
examples.english: Meshmesh was waiting for them at the apartment door.
examples.transliteration: Meshmesh kanet mestanyahom 3and bab el sha2qa.

examples.arabic: أنا بفتح الباب وهما بيدخلوا؛ الشقة بتاعتي صغيرة بس حلوة.
examples.english: I open the door and they enter; my apartment is small but nice.
examples.transliteration: Ana bafta7 el bab w homa byedkholo; el sha22a beta3ty soghayyara bas 7elwa.

examples.english: But where is a new apartment for the newlyweds?

examples.arabic: سارة قالت أنا هروق الشقة وأجهز الغدا بدري عشان عندي مشوار مهم
examples.english: Sara said: I will tidy the apartment and prepare lunch early because I have an important errand.
examples.transliteration: Sara qalet ana ha-rawwaq el-shaqqa w aghahhez el-ghada badri ashan andi meshwar mohem.

examples.arabic: ريحة اكل حلوة قوي طلعت من شقة اميرة
examples.english: A very nice food smell came out of Amira's apartment.
examples.transliteration: rīḥet akl ḥelwa qawiṭ ṭalaʿet men shaʾʾet Amīra.
examples.storyTitle: A Nice Smell from the Neighbors' Apartment
